entities.summary: "Love Don't Let Me Go" is a song by French DJ and producer David Guetta, featuring vocals from singer and long-time collaborator Chris Willis. The track was released as the second single from his debut studio album, Just a Little More Love, although served as the album's lead single in the United Kingdom. The main remix of the song, "Love Don't Let Me Go ", was also released as single in 2006.
